purpose: 5年の共通スケールで CBX を CBD/THC と同じ run に載せる bridge 計測。単独系列は各語のピーク=100 に正規化されるため化合物間比較ができないので、CBX + CBD + THC を 1 リクエストの compare_terms で、同一 geo / timeframe / window のもと測る。単独系列の平均を合成・平均して作った値ではない。既存の 5年共通スケール setA–D（窓 2021-10-17_2026-10-18）とは窓が異なる別観測（ISS-20261024-COL-016 の Google Trends 部分）。

temporal_provenance.boundary_semantics: relative timeframe resolved by the collector at request time; weekly buckets (Sunday start) label the series; observed range 2021-10-31..2026-11-01
limitations: collector window type is relative_duration; the absolute requested window cannot be expressed exactly (boundary semantics unverified, c.md §6.2)
'today 5-y' is resolved nominally at the recorded reference time; Google Trends resolves it at request time and the actual boundaries are unverified (c.md §6.3)
coverage is recorded as partial/unknown until boundary verification (c.md §9)
